author: Nayan j Nath
description: Shiva Dol is a historic 18th-century temple complex in Sivasagar, Assam, comprising Sivadol (dedicated to Lord Shiva), Vishnudol (to Lord Vishnu), and Devidol (to Goddess Durga), along with a museum. Built in 1734 by Queen Bar Raja Ambika during the reign of Ahom king Swargadeo Siva Singha, the temples stand on the banks of the grand Sivasagar Tank (Borpukhuri). The Sivadol, towering at 104 feet and crowned with a golden dome, is the tallest and most prominent, symbolizing the architectural grandeur of the Ahom dynasty.
